Fictional retrospective maximum-absolute-residual heuristic using one fixed calibration target interval strictly before the holdout. At each one-day holdout origin, a candidate is admitted only when its declared target release is available by that origin and its seven feature dates were available at its own forecast origin. Holdout target labels never become calibration residuals, though released earlier holdout observations may be forecast features at later origins. Missing or unpublished targets remain missing; exact evaluated-origin numerator and denominator are reported. The 7x21 synthetic split visits 28 distinct target dates once by construction; the current implementation has no memoization or expiration heap and this count is not a speed or latency claim. The output remains experimental and uncalibrated, has no nominal interval guarantee, source permission, authenticated publisher vintages, empirical forecasting, true-demand evidence or future coverage guarantee. Historical 154-to-28 cache measurements describe superseded code only.
